newsitem.title: CROATIA: Austrian Volksbanken AG opens branch in Croatia.
newsitem.headline: Austrian Volksbanken AG opens branch in Croatia.

text.p: Austrian bank Volksbanken AG (OeVAG) on Tuesday inaugurated its branch bank Volksbank d.d. in Zagreb and said it planned to create a network of offices in Croatia, the state news agency HINA said.
"We will try to be a bank offering quality and security," HINA quoted OeVAG head Klaus Thalhammer as saying.

The bank will focus its activities on small and medium-size Croatian firms and on state-owned companies awaiting privatisation. "Special attention" will be given to firms which are export-oriented, Thalhammer was quoted as saying.
As it also plans to have private citizens, tradesmen and the self-employed for clients, the bank plans to set up a network of offices in the country.
OeVAG obtained a licence from the National Bank of Croatia in January, allowing it to open Volksbank d.d. in Zagreb. -- Laura Lui, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
